# authwise_factor_totp (Data Source)

Builds a FactorTOTP config and exposes its google.protobuf.Any encoding as `any`. Makes no API calls.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `algorithm` (String)
- `digits` (Number)
- `issuer_label` (String)
- `period` (Number)
- `skew` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `any` (String) protojson-encoded google.protobuf.Any (includes `@type`); reference this from Any-typed resource attributes.
